Commit 38cce304a23a7f5eb8f2282d14f09a79c01eb9c6 updated source/testscript/structuredefinition-TestScript.xml and invariant tests, adding the split constraints to setup, test, and common assert elements as tst-7/tst-8, tst-13/tst-14, and tst-20/tst-21. Merge commit 560a86e3f9b1f4bce84979e46a23aa33f7590826 records the PR merge on 2025-08-25.
additional_context: Current core no longer has active TestScript source. Commit f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 removed TestScript, TestReport, and TestPlan source entries and deleted source/testscript while adding an additional-ig-list pointer to the FHIR Testing IG. Current source/ballot-intro.html links TestScript to the Testing IG, and the current Testing IG JSON contains the split constraints matching FHIR-50529.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The current core checkout is not the authoritative place to edit TestScript constraints, and the current external TestScript artifact already carries the approved FHIR-50529 semantics.
